preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of the array N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N)) for N, A in zip(Ns, As))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i].split()[0] == str(rotations[i][0]) and output_lines[i].split()[1] == str(rotations[i][1]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains the correct rotation index and the maximum number of inversions for the corresponding test case.
